evidenceMethodDefinitions.renderedPixels: Dated state-identified screenshots of the real native app. Use enough parent-scroll captures to inspect every mandatory visible field. Does not prove semantics, hit bounds or callbacks.
evidenceMethodDefinitions.nativeTypography: Resolved native font/layout instrumentation at the actual rendered text, identifying native system font family, base point/sp size and effective native scaling. Source declarations, screenshot resemblance, and current-runtime success do not count. If unavailable, mark unassessed.
evidenceMethodDefinitions.nativeBounds: Actual native runtime/accessibility/instrumentation frames in logical units, with coordinate-space and parent scroll offset. Source layout constants and screenshot guesses do not count.
evidenceMethodDefinitions.nativeSemantics: Actual native accessibility/test-tree names, roles, traits, values, enabled/selected state, and identifiers. Source annotations or pixels do not count.
evidenceMethodDefinitions.callbackTrace: Captured typed onAction invocations from actual native activation, aligned to case/state and model echo. Static handler code and claimed logs do not count.
evidenceMethodDefinitions.nativeInteraction: Actual native tap, accessibility activation, scroll, and same-instance model replacement trace. A script without execution proof does not count. This also includes actual native host environment/configuration observations; source constants or planned setup do not establish the active environment.
evidenceMethodDefinitions.sourceAudit: Read anonymous implementation source for the public API and availability/minimum-deployment checks only. Current-runtime success is not minimum-deployment proof.

setPredicatePolicy: A set-valued equality is one property of an observed collection, not a whole-rule pass. Preserve expected and observed row/field IDs and evidence coverage for every expected entry. A missing observation makes the predicate UNASSESSED; a complete observation showing a mismatch makes it FAIL. No unseen row may be silently treated as absent, selected=false, covered, readable, or compliant.
identifierUniversePolicy: For documentedIdentifierSetEquals, compare descendant documented fixed rr.* identifiers plus all rr.option.* and rr.size.* prefixes, including stale/unexpected IDs. Ignore additional unrelated test identifiers. Order is irrelevant to this set predicate. Visible-region predicates likewise compare required regions/status exclusions; majorRegionFlowEquals separately checks major visual order.

P01.scope: All eight environments; native width/origin and actual environment once per case; complete parent-scroll coverage at 18 visual states; exact newly introduced/changed text per visual field member; 24 focused controlled-action probes.
P01.deliberateSampling: Unchanged text is captured for visibility coverage but not given a second independent exact-string assertion at every update. No new exact-string PASS is claimed where not keyed.

P02.scope: The unchanged 196 common source/API/compatibility predicates; all seven typed actions exercised; complete concrete action payload equality and interval count.

P03.scope: All gate precedence branches, effective/stale/disabled option and size selection, caller echo delays, 15 whole-model replacements, identity replacement, irrelevant-field submission handling. Native selection rows remain individually recorded; no-echo actions use focused pixel and native probes.

P04.scope: Editing in all cases; complete in C05, submitting pixel structure in C06 and native structure in C01. Every initial/replacement has a documented identifier set; every visual state has visible-region and flow predicates.

P05.scope: Representative light/dark color roles, radii and spacing; native touch bounds when a control is introduced; narrow/enlarged/RTL layout across cases; selected/disabled distinctions; three native typography probe contexts.
P05.deliberateSampling: Shared font/token/row style labels are sampled across cases rather than repeated on every row and every update. No claim is made that every appearance × direction × content × font × state combination was exhaustively observed.

P06.scope: New/changed native roles, enabled state and names; selection per visible option/size row at model states; checkbox/expanded state, individual button labels and callback activations; read order at initial/status/identity changes; decoration exclusion.
P06.deliberateSampling: Unchanged role/name declarations are not reasserted after every echo; absence/selection and critical decisions are still checked at every model state.

P07.scope: All keyed predicates name one allowed evidence class; native execution and callback intervals are required. Missing methods, unknown typography, unsupported geometry or unbound artifacts remain explicit UNASSESSED.

evidenceResultSchema.groupRule: One outcome per explicit member key; no aggregate group PASS until every member is PASS.
evidenceResultSchema.setRule: Supply actualObservedSet and expected-entry coverage records; any unknown entry prevents PASS.
evidenceResultSchema.unassessedRule: Record inaccessibleReason and missingEvidenceMethod; do not replace actual runtime evidence with source or pixels of another kind.
